title: GRTO: Bootstrapped Group Relative Tool Optimization for Referring Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2605.23500v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Referring segmentation requires reasoning to connect language with visual evidence and identify the intended target in challenging scenarios. This makes GRPO a natural choice for training VLMs together with a segmentation tool. However, existing approaches optimize only the VLM, assuming that the tool is perfect and leaving it untouched. This assumption is particularly limiting when the tool faces domain shift, as segmentation errors can undermine even correct reasoning. We therefore argue that the segmentation tool should be optimized together with the reasoning policy. However, this is challenging because policy optimization and differentiable tool learning rely on fundamentally different objectives. In this work, we introduce group relative tool optimization (GRTO), a mathematically grounded two-stage framework for jointly optimizing a policy and its differentiable tool. translated_title: GRTO：用于指代分割的自举式组相对工具优化
translated_abstract: 指代分割需要通过推理将语言与视觉证据相联系，并在具有挑战性的场景中识别出预期目标。这使得GRPO成为将视觉语言模型（VLM）与分割工具联合训练的自然选择。然而，现有方法仅优化VLM，假设分割工具是完美的而不对其加以改动。当工具面临域偏移时，这一假设的局限性尤为明显，因为分割错误甚至会破坏原本正确的推理。因此，我们认为分割工具应当与推理策略一同进行优化。然而，这颇具挑战性，因为策略优化与可微工具学习依赖于本质上不同的目标。在本工作中，我们提出了组相对工具优化（GRTO），一个具有数学理论基础的两阶段框架，用于联合优化策略及其可微工具。其核心思想是首先使工具与策略（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出GRTO，一个基于数学原理的两阶段框架，首次将推理策略与可微分割工具联合优化，解决现有方法只优化VLM、在域偏移下分割错误损害正确推理的问题。
en_tdlr: GRTO is a mathematically grounded two-stage framework that jointly optimizes the reasoning policy and its differentiable segmentation tool, overcoming the limitation of existing methods that leave the tool untouched and suffer from segmentation errors under domain shift.
